articles.summary_zh: 10月初，一名20岁的科普特基督徒被伊斯兰国家集团绑架并杀害。Milad Malak住在埃及的Sebarbay ，在当地的科普特教会担任教会执事。然而，由于该国的经济衰退，他于9月2日前往利比亚寻找工作。他制作了......在利比亚殉难的埃及基督徒后首次出现在国际基督教关注。
articles.title_zh: 埃及基督徒在利比亚殉道
articles.content: In early October, a 20-year-old Coptic Christian was kidnapped and killed at the hands of the Islamic State group. Milad Malak lived in Sebarbay, Egypt, and served as a church deacon at a local Coptic church. However, because of the country’s economic decline, he traveled to Libya on Sept. 2 to find work. He made a day’s journey with two Muslim friends and arrived in Zliten, where they stayed with other Egyptian migrant workers. On the morning of Oct. 4, ISIS militants kidnapped them. The captors subjected the group to abuse while they held them hostage for ransom money. Milad’s friends were released after their families paid a $4,700 ransom. They are now receiving medical treatment at a hospital in Egypt. Milad’s sister, Madonna Malek, told Worthy News that their family paid a ransom, but because he was the only Christian in the group, his kidnappers refused to release him and violently pressured him to convert to Islam. Milad stood strong in his faith until the end. He told his persecutors, “Even if you cut me into pieces, I would never renounce my faith.” When the militants realized they could not force him to abandon his God, they killed him. Faithful Until the End After hearing about his death from his friends, Milad’s family appealed to the Egyptian government, asking them to intervene and demand that his body be returned home. Several weeks went by until it was finally released, and on Oct. 28, grieving family members and fellow Christians gathered to celebrate the life of their beloved son and friend. “He was faithful to Christ till his last breath,” a family friend said. Open Doors ranked Libya as the ninth most dangerous place to be a Christian. A Muslim-majority nation, Christians face heavy pressure to abandon their faith. Milad’s death has reminded believers of the massacre that occurred in 2015, when 20 Coptic Christians and one Ghanaian were beheaded by militants in Libya for standing strong in their faith. Milad joins them as yet another martyr who inspires Christians worldwide to be bold witnesses for Christ until the very end. Story by Bella Agnello To read more news stories, visit the ICC Newsroom . For interviews, please email us . To support ICC’s work around the world, please give to our Where Most Needed Fund . 10月初,一名20岁的科普特·克里斯蒂安被伊斯兰国集团绑架并杀害. 米拉德·马拉克居住在埃及塞巴拜,并在当地的科普特教堂担任教堂执事. 然而,由于该国经济下滑,他于9月2日前往利比亚寻找工作。

他与两个穆斯林朋友共度了一天的旅程,并抵达兹利滕,在那里他们与其他埃及移徙工人住在一起。 10月4日上午,伊斯兰国武装分子绑架了他们。 抓捕者在以赎金为人质时虐待该团伙。 Mirad的朋友在家人支付了4700美元的赎金后被释放。

他们目前正在埃及的一家医院接受治疗。 米拉德的妹妹麦当娜·马利克(Madonna Malek)告诉沃西新闻,他们的家人支付了赎金,但由于他是这群人中唯一的基督徒,绑匪拒绝释放他,并用暴力逼迫他皈依伊斯兰教. 米拉德坚守信仰,直到最后.

他对他的迫害者说:即使你把我割成碎片,我也不会放弃我的信仰。 当激进分子意识到他们不能强迫他放弃上帝时,他们杀了他. Milad的家人在从朋友那里得知他的死讯后,

几个星期过去了,直到最终发行,10月28日,悲痛的家人和基督徒同胞聚集在一起,庆祝他们心爱的儿子和朋友的生命. 一位家庭朋友说:“他忠于基督直到最后一口气”。 开放门将利比亚列为第九个最危险的基督徒地点.

作为一个穆斯林占多数的民族,基督徒面临着放弃信仰的沉重压力. Milad的死让信徒想起了2015年发生的大屠杀,当时利比亚有20名科普特基督徒和1名加纳人因坚守信仰而被激进分子斩首. 米拉德与他们一起成为另一个烈士,他激励全世界的基督徒成为基督的大胆见证,直到最后.

articles.title_zh: 加剧迫害第4部分（共4部分） ：当经济压力结束时，迫害开始了
articles.content: By ICC Fellow Lisa Navarrette For years, Fadi has told his children the same thing: We stay. He is a Christian father in Lebanon. His family has lived in the same town for generations, and his parents are buried nearby. Fadi’s children were baptized in the church where he married his wife, Nour. His small business survived political unrest, the economic collapse, the Beirut port explosion, and another round of regional conflict. Leaving always felt like surrender. But lately, the calculation has changed. Fuel costs have risen again. Groceries take a larger share of the family’s income. Electricity is unreliable, so the business depends partly on a generator. Transportation costs more. His oldest daughter has been accepted to a university abroad, while his younger son talks openly about finding work in Europe. One evening, Fadi places two folders on the kitchen table. One contains bills. The other contains immigration documents. “We don’t have to decide tonight,” she said. Fadi looks at the paperwork for a long time. Years earlier, violence made the family afraid to leave home. Now economics is making them wonder whether they should leave the country. That is the final link in the chain this series examines. Fighting to Stay High fuel prices do not create religious persecution. But when families have already endured violence, displacement, discrimination, destroyed livelihoods, or political instability, rising energy costs can make recovery harder and staying less sustainable. In 2026, the World Bank warned that the Middle East conflict had created a major energy shock, raising fuel prices, increasing inflation, disrupting transportation and logistics, and weakening economic growth. Its October 2026 regional economic update found that fragile and conflict-affected economies were experiencing especially severe pressure , with poverty still rising in parts of the region even as it declined elsewhere. Those regional trends eventually become household questions: Can the business stay open? Can the family still afford food? Will there be jobs for the children? Is rebuilding worth the cost? Lebanon illustrates how those pressures can accumulate. Christians there have not experienced the same mass expulsion seen in parts of Iraq or Syria, but International Christian Concern (ICC) has documented how economic collapse, political instability, regional conflict, and emigration continue to weaken one of the Middle East’s most important Christian communities. No single crisis explains why a family leaves. That is what makes the process easy to overlook. A Christian family may survive violence but lose its savings. It may survive political instability but lose its business. It may rebuild after displacement only to discover that electricity, fuel, food, and transportation have become increasingly expensive. Eventually, the question is no longer only whether the family is safe. It is whether the family can build a future. Affording Daily Life The same dynamic is evident in Syria, where many people have tried to return after years of war. In May 2026, ICC reported that about 1.67 million refugees and 1.9 million internally displaced Syrians had returned since December 2024. Yet the agency warned that damaged housing, limited livelihoods, weak infrastructure, poverty, and restricted access to basic services continued to threaten the sustainability of those returns. A separate 2026 assessment hosted by UNHCR reached a similar conclusion : whether people remain after returning depends heavily on housing, employment, services, and economic opportunity. For Christian communities, that distinction matters. Imagine a family returning to a Syrian town after years abroad. They repair part of their home. Their children reenter school. The father begins rebuilding a small business. Then expenses start adding up. Electricity remains unreliable. Fuel for the generator costs more. Transportation to work and school takes a larger share of income. Food prices
articles.content_zh:
由ICC研究员莉萨·纳瓦雷特(Lisa Navarrette) 多年来,法迪对他的孩子说了同样的话:我们留下。 他是黎巴嫩的基督教父亲. 他的家族世代居住在同一个城镇,父母也葬在附近. Fadi的孩子在与妻子Nour结婚的教堂接受洗礼。

他的小企业在政治动荡,经济崩溃,贝鲁特港口爆炸以及另一轮区域冲突中幸存下来. 离开总是觉得投降。 但最近,计算方式发生了变化。 燃料成本再次上升。 食谱占家庭收入的较大份额。 电力不可靠,因此业务部分依赖于发电机. 运输成本更高。

他的大女儿被录取到国外的一所大学,而小儿子则公开谈论在欧洲找工作. 一天晚上,法迪把两个文件夹放在厨房桌子上. 一个有账单。 另一个文件载有移民证件。 “我们不必在今晚决定, 法迪很长一段时间都在看文件 几年前,暴力使家庭不敢离家。

现在经济学让他们怀疑他们是否应该出国。 这是本系列审查的链条的最后环节。 高油价斗争不会造成宗教迫害。

但是,当家庭已经忍受了暴力、流离失所、歧视、生计被摧毁或政治不稳定时,能源成本的上升会使恢复更加困难,并降低可持续性。

2026年,世界银行警告说,中东冲突造成了严重的能源冲击,燃料价格上涨,通货膨胀加剧,交通和后勤中断,经济增长减弱.

其2026年10月的区域经济最新情况发现,脆弱和受冲突影响的经济体正承受着特别严重的压力,该区域部分地区的贫困现象仍在加剧,尽管其他地区的贫困状况有所下降。 这些区域趋势最终成为家庭问题:企业能否继续开放? 家人还能买得起食物吗? 孩子们会有工作吗?

重建值得付出代价吗? 黎巴嫩说明了这些压力如何能够累积。 但国际基督教关注组织(ICC)记录了经济崩溃、政治不稳定、地区冲突和移民继续削弱中东最重要的基督教社区之一。

没有一个危机能解释一个家庭为什么离开。 这使得这一进程容易被忽视。 一个基督教家庭可能会在暴力中幸存下来,但却会失去积蓄。 它可能在政治不稳定的情况下生存下来,但失去了业务。 它可能在流离失所后重建,只为了发现电力、燃料、粮食和交通越来越昂贵。

最后,问题不再仅仅是家庭是否安全。 家庭是否能够建立未来。 每日生活 同样的动态在叙利亚也很明显,许多人在多年战争之后试图返回叙利亚。 2026年5月,国际刑事法院报告说,自2024年12月以来,约有167万难民和190万境内流离失所的叙利亚人返回。

然而,该机构警告说,住房受损、生计有限、基础设施薄弱、贫穷以及获得基本服务的机会有限,继续威胁着这些回返的可持续性。 难民署主办的2026年的单独评估得出了类似结论:人们返回后是否仍留在当地,在很大程度上取决于住房、就业、服务和经济机会。

对基督教社区来说,这种区别很重要。 想象一个家庭在海外多年后返回叙利亚城镇。 他们修补了一部分家 他们的孩子重新入学。 父亲开始重建小生意. 然后费用开始增加。 电力仍然不可靠。 发电机的燃料成本更高。 工作和上学的交通占收入的较大份额。

articles.content: How old were you when you first learned that Jesus loves you? Perhaps you’ve always known it and can’t remember a day when you didn’t know the song “Jesus Loves Me” or couldn’t recite John 3:16 by heart. Maybe you were a teenager and learned about Jesus’ love through a friend or church summer camp. Or were in college and went to a concert where the gospel was clearly articulated. Maybe you were in the trenches of the workforce, and a coworker boldly shared with you about the God who radically changed their life. Regardless of how old you were, each of us who has chosen to follow Jesus has an origin story — a moment in our lives when the knowledge that “Jesus loves me, this I know, for the Bible tells me so” moved from head knowledge to heart belief. And from then on, our lives were transformed forever. This is the truth of the gospel and the power of understanding that Jesus loves you. People around the world are discovering the personal truth of John 3:16 for themselves in a language and format they clearly understand. Explore why understanding that “God so loved the world” transforms entire communities → A Changing Reality Throughout Christian history, the gospel has spread from one community to the next. Stories were told and retold, Scripture was translated, churches were planted, and discipleship deepened as people learned more about Jesus. Bible translation is foundational to all ministries of the church. It fuels evangelism, church planting, discipleship and more. It equips people to move from a blurry picture of who God is to a clear understanding and personal encounter with Jesus as Lord. Through Scripture, people are able to read, hear or see the love of God on display. Just two decades ago, most of the world’s language communities still needed Bible translation work to begin , let alone be completed. But praise God, in the last few years, we’ve seen tremendous progress made, with Bible translation underway in more languages than ever before . While the change in numbers is exciting, what’s more important is what they signify: Every number represents a person who has a story that matters to God. For these communities, the stories of future generations are being completely rewritten as children will now grow up never remembering a day when they didn’t have access to God’s Word in a language and format they clearly understand. That statement bears repeating: There will now be people who never remember a day when they didn’t have access to God’s Word in a language and format they clearly understand. From the first word of Genesis to the last word of Revelation, the Bible tells one incredible story: God’s love for the world and His invitation for people from every nation and language to know Him. Get a glimpse of how God continues writing this story today as more and more people are experiencing the power of His Word. Watch the video → A New Generation Growing Up With God’s Word Let’s take a look at some of the recent communities that are experiencing not only life transformation but generational transformation as they encounter Jesus personally through Scripture. Jakalteko | Guatemala The Jakalteko Bible was dedicated in July 2026 in Guatemala! During the celebration, John 1:1-18 was read aloud — a passage that focuses on Christ, the eternal Word and our Redeemer. Early on, many women in the community memorized Job 19 . Like Job, they had faced various hardships in their lives and identified with his suffering. The book reminded them that God remains in control and that, in the midst of difficult circumstances, their Redeemer will deliver them and comfort them in their pain. Today, they have the full counsel of God’s Word and can now see this Redeemer fulfilled in Jesus in the New Testament. They are overjoyed that the Bible has arrived in the language they were born into! When the Bible was distributed, one mother who is raising her family alone said with joy and tears: “Thank God we have the Bible in our language. Now

你第一次得知耶稣爱你时多大了? 或许你一直都知道, 也不记得有一天你不知道“耶稣爱我”的歌曲, 或许你还是个少年, 或者在大学时,去参加一个音乐会,其中福音被明确表达出来.

也许你在劳动力的战壕里, 一个合作者大胆地与你分享上帝 谁彻底改变了他们的生活。 无论你多大,选择跟随耶稣的我们每个人都有一个起源故事——在我们生活中的这一刻,“耶稣爱我,我知道,因为圣经如此告诉我”的知识从头知识转移到心信。

从那时起,我们的生活就永远改变了 这是耶稣爱你的福音和理解的力量的真理. 世界各地的人们正在用他们明白的语言和格式,为自己发现约翰3:16的个人真理.

探讨为什么“上帝如此热爱世界”会改变整个社区? 基督教历史上不断变化的现实,福音从一个社区传播到另一个社区。 故事被讲述和重播,圣经被翻译,教堂被种植,随着人们更多地了解耶稣,门徒身份加深. 圣经翻译是教会所有各部的基础.

它为福音派,教会的种植,门徒活动等等提供了燃料. 它使人们能够从模糊的上帝是谁的画面走向一个明确的理解和与耶稣作为主的个人交锋. 通过圣经,人们能够阅读,听到或看到上帝的爱在展示.

就在20年前,世界上大多数语言社区仍然需要开始圣经翻译工作,更不用说完成了。 但赞美上帝, 在过去几年里, 我们看到了巨大的进步,

虽然数字的变化令人振奋, 每个数字都代表着一个对上帝很重要的故事的人. 对于这些社群来说, 后代的故事正在被完全改写, 因为孩子们现在长大了,

这一声明值得重申: 现在人们将永远不记得有一天,他们无法以他们明白的语言和格式获得上帝的启示。 从创世纪的第一个字到启示录的最后一个字,圣经讲述了一个不可思议的故事:上帝对世界的爱,以及他邀请来自每个民族和语言的人来了解他.

当越来越多的人正在经历着他的话语的力量时, 让我们看看最近的一些社区,

危地马拉 2026年7月危地马拉献上雅卡尔特科圣经! 在庆典期间,约翰1:1-18被高声朗诵——这一段以基督,永恒之言和我们的救世主为焦点. 早期,许多社区妇女怀念工作19。 与Job一样,他们的生活也面临各种困难,并认同他的痛苦。

这本书提醒他们,上帝仍然在控制之中,在困难的情况下,他们的救赎者会将他们送去,并在他们的痛苦中安慰他们. 今天,他们有充分的神话的劝告,现在可以看到这个救世主在新约中的耶稣实现了. 他们太高兴了 圣经已经用他们生下来的语言传下来了!

articles.source: Wycliffe Bible Translators · 译经故事
articles.summary: Today on the Faithly Podcast, Alicia Lee welcomes Melissa Paredes, Senior Director of Content Marketing at Wycliffe Bible Translators USA, for a meaningful conversation about Bible translation, motherhood, and the life-changing power of Scripture.   The post  When God’s Word Becomes Personal  appeared first on  Wycliffe .
articles.summary_zh: 今天，在Faithly播客上， Alicia Lee欢迎Wycliffe Bible Translators USA内容营销高级总监Melissa Paredes就圣经翻译、母性以及圣经改变生活的力量进行有意义的对话。当上帝的话语成为个人时，这篇文章首先出现在威克里夫。
articles.content: How old were you when you first learned that Jesus loves you? Perhaps you’ve always known it and can’t remember a day when you didn’t know the song “Jesus Loves Me” or couldn’t recite John 3:16 by heart. Maybe you were a teenager and learned about Jesus’ love through a friend or church summer camp. Or were in college and went to a concert where the gospel was clearly articulated. Maybe you were in the trenches of the workforce, and a coworker boldly shared with you about the God who radically changed their life. Regardless of how old you were, each of us who has chosen to follow Jesus has an origin story — a moment in our lives when the knowledge that “Jesus loves me, this I know, for the Bible tells me so” moved from head knowledge to heart belief. And from then on, our lives were transformed forever. This is the truth of the gospel and the power of understanding that Jesus loves you. People around the world are discovering the personal truth of John 3:16 for themselves in a language and format they clearly understand. Explore why understanding that “God so loved the world” transforms entire communities → A Changing Reality Throughout Christian history, the gospel has spread from one community to the next. Stories were told and retold, Scripture was translated, churches were planted, and discipleship deepened as people learned more about Jesus. Bible translation is foundational to all ministries of the church. It fuels evangelism, church planting, discipleship and more. It equips people to move from a blurry picture of who God is to a clear understanding and personal encounter with Jesus as Lord. Through Scripture, people are able to read, hear or see the love of God on display. Just two decades ago, most of the world’s language communities still needed Bible translation work to begin , let alone be completed. But praise God, in the last few years, we’ve seen tremendous progress made, with Bible translation underway in more languages than ever before . While the change in numbers is exciting, what’s more important is what they signify: Every number represents a person who has a story that matters to God. For these communities, the stories of future generations are being completely rewritten as children will now grow up never remembering a day when they didn’t have access to God’s Word in a language and format they clearly understand. That statement bears repeating: There will now be people who never remember a day when they didn’t have access to God’s Word in a language and format they clearly understand. From the first word of Genesis to the last word of Revelation, the Bible tells one incredible story: God’s love for the world and His invitation for people from every nation and language to know Him. Get a glimpse of how God continues writing this story today as more and more people are experiencing the power of His Word. Watch the video → A New Generation Growing Up With God’s Word Let’s take a look at some of the recent communities that are experiencing not only life transformation but generational transformation as they encounter Jesus personally through Scripture. Jakalteko | Guatemala The Jakalteko Bible was dedicated in July 2026 in Guatemala! During the celebration, John 1:1-18 was read aloud — a passage that focuses on Christ, the eternal Word and our Redeemer. Early on, many women in the community memorized Job 19 . Like Job, they had faced various hardships in their lives and identified with his suffering. The book reminded them that God remains in control and that, in the midst of difficult circumstances, their Redeemer will deliver them and comfort them in their pain. Today, they have the full counsel of God’s Word and can now see this Redeemer fulfilled in Jesus in the New Testament. They are overjoyed that the Bible has arrived in the language they were born into! When the Bible was distributed, one mother who is raising her family alone said with joy and tears: “Thank God we have the Bible in our language. Now

articles.summary_zh:
上帝继续召唤 他的族人将福音传到地底 11月9日,在俄亥俄州代顿附近的第一浸信会Kettling教堂的Sugarcreek校区,33名国际传教委员会传教士站在家人、朋友和支持者面前,申明他们服从这一呼吁。

独立浸信会的受托人任命了得到充分支持的传教士,他们代表10个州,包括俄亥俄州的两名候选人,以及许多致力于圣的南方浸信会教会。
articles.title_zh: 俄亥俄州派遣庆祝活动确认33名IMB传教士为全球服务
articles.content: Participants at the IMB Sending Celebration on Nov. 9, 2026, celebrated God's faithfulness in sending 33 new missionaries to the nations. Held at the Sugarcreek campus of First Baptist Kettering near Dayton, Ohio, the event launched the State Convention of Baptists in Ohio annual gathering. For security reasons, some newly appointed missionaries are not publicly identified. IMB Photo God continues to call His people to carry the gospel to the ends of the earth. During a Sending Celebration Nov. 9 at the Sugarcreek Campus of First Baptist Church Kettering, near Dayton, Ohio, 33 International Mission Board missionaries stood before family, friends and supporters, affirming their obedience to that call. Trustees of the IMB appointed the fully supported missionaries who represent 10 states – including two candidates from Ohio – and many Southern Baptist churches committed to sending and sustaining those called by God to go to the mission field. Senior Pastor Chad Keck welcomed those in attendance, sharing his appreciation for the partnership with Southern Baptist churches to cooperatively send and support missionaries. The Sending Celebration is meeting in conjunction with the State Convention of Baptists in Ohio. Chad Keck, senior pastor of First Baptist Kettering near Dayton, Ohio, left, and Jeremy Westbrook, executive director-treasurer of the State Convention of Baptists in Ohio, right, welcome guests gathered for the IMB Sending Celebration, which kicked off the convention’s annual gathering. IMB Photo Among those who shared their stories include a couple who answered an unexpected call later in life, a couple who are returning to Albania and to people they could not forget; and a couple who moved from welcoming the nations in Canada to going to Fiji. All of them shared their stories before the Sending Celebration. Unexpected invitation to go On Dec. 5, 2025, what seemed like an ordinary FaceTime call became a turning point for Rob Boss. As he spoke with his daughter, Hannah, during her IMB training, Rob sensed God speaking clearly to his heart: “You can do this too.” The impression was unexpected. After decades of writing, Christian education, seminary teaching and active support of missions, overseas service had never been part of Rob and Stephanie Boss’ plans. “It wasn’t an audible voice, but it was so clear,” Rob said. “It was Him. It was so kind and so gentle and so encouraging.” The moment drove him to his knees in surrender. When Stephanie came home later that day, he told her he believed God was calling them to the nations. Her response was immediate. “Thrilled is the right answer,” she said. The next day, the couple contacted the IMB and began the application process. Though missions had long been part of their family’s story, Rob and Stephanie Boss sensed God leading them to overseas service while encouraging their daughter, Hannah, during her missionary training. Sent by Wedgwood Baptist Church in Fort Worth, Texas, they are now headed to Colombia, where they will serve through theological education. IMB Photo Looking back, the Bosses see the Lord’s hand preparing them long before they realized where He was leading. “God brought us together in the summer of 1990 at Glorieta, New Mexico, where we met and married,” Stephanie said during the Sending Celebration. What followed was years of ministry, teaching, parenting and navigating life’s unexpected turns, which taught them to hold plans loosely and trust God completely. “We did not have a clue about what life held in front of us,” Stephanie said. “We just knew we wanted to follow the Lord.” Their calling also continues a family legacy. Rob’s mother served with the IMB in Africa after retirement, helping inspire Hannah’s service in South Korea. Now, three generations of the same family have answered God’s call to the nations. Rob and Stephanie expressed deep gratitude for their sending church, Wedgwood Baptist Church in Fort Worth, whose strong commitment to missions

2026年11月9日的IMB送信庆典的参与者,庆祝上帝向各国派遣33名新传教士的忠诚. 该活动在俄亥俄州代顿附近的第一浸信会Kettling的Sugarcreek校园举行,在俄亥俄州发起了浸信会州议会年会。 出于安全考虑,一些新任命的传教士没有公开身份.

IMB图片神继续呼叫 他的族人将福音传到地底 11月9日,在俄亥俄州代顿附近的第一浸信会Kettling教堂的Sugarcreek校区,33名国际传教委员会传教士站在家人、朋友和支持者面前,申明他们服从这一呼吁。

IMB的受托人任命了代表10个州的全力支持的传教士 — — 包括俄亥俄州的两名候选人 — — 以及许多南方浸信会教会承诺将那些被上帝召唤去传教的传教士送去并维持下去.

高级牧师Chad Keck欢迎与会者,与他一样感谢与美南浸信会教会合作派遣和支持传教士。 送教庆典会与俄亥俄州的浸信会州会议同时举行.

俄亥俄州代顿附近第一浸信会Ketting的资深牧师查德·凯克(Chad Keck)左翼,俄亥俄州浸信会执行董事兼创始人杰里米·韦斯特布鲁克(Jeremy Westbrook)右翼欢迎前来参加IMB送信庆典的来宾,这驱散了大会的年度集会。

在分享自己故事的人中,有一对夫妇在生活后期意外地接了电话,一对夫妇正在返回阿尔巴尼亚,一对夫妇无法忘记;一对夫妇从欢迎加拿大各国搬到斐济。 他们都分享了他们的故事 在送信庆典之前。 意外邀请 Dec 上。

5, 2025, 看起来像一个普通的FaceTime电话成为Rob Boss的转折点. 当他和他的女儿汉娜在IMB训练期间交谈时,罗布感应到上帝对他说的很清楚:“你也可以这样做。” 印象出乎意料。

经过几十年的写作、基督教教育、神学院教学和对使团的积极支持,海外服务从未成为罗布和斯蒂芬妮·博斯计划的一部分。 Rob说, “这不是一个声音, “这是他。 它是如此善良和温柔,如此鼓舞人心。” 那一刻,他被迫跪在地上投降。

当斯蒂芬妮当天晚些时候回家时,他告诉她,他相信上帝在召唤他们到各国. 她立即作出反应。 她说,“令人惊叹的是正确的答案。” 次日,夫妇联系IMB,开始了申请程序.

虽然传教团早就是他们家庭故事的一部分,但罗布和史蒂芬妮·博斯感知到,在传教团训练期间,他们带领他们到海外服务,同时鼓励他们的女儿汉娜。 由德克萨斯州沃思堡的韦奇伍德浸信会(Wedgwood Baptist Church)派遣,他们现在前往哥伦比亚,通过神学教育服务.

IMB照片回想起来,老板们看到主的手 在他们意识到在哪里之前很早就准备了 他是领导。 " 1990年夏天,上帝把我们带到了新墨西哥州格洛里埃塔,我们在那里相遇并结婚。 " Stephanie在送货庆典上说。

接下来是多年的教职、教职、养育和过着意想不到的转折,教他们松动计划,完全相信上帝。 Stephanie说:“我们不知道我们面前的生活是什么。” 我们只知道我们想跟随主。 他们的召唤也延续了家庭遗产。

罗布的母亲退休后在非洲为IMB效力,帮助激励汉娜在韩国服役. 现在,同一家庭的三代人响应了上帝向各国发出的呼吁。 Rob和Stephanie深表感谢他们派来的教会Worth堡的Wedgwood浸信会教堂,他们坚定致力于使命

articles.content: The following is the substance of a pamphlet published by Archibald G. Brown, a student and then great ally of C. H. Spurgeon in the cause of the gospel in London. Brown here draws attention to a practice that was gaining ground in the churches of his day: that of holding ‘amusements’ of various kinds, which obscured, diverted from, and in some cases replaced the proper ministry of local churches. Brown was savagely attacked in the wake of the publication of the pamphlet, derided as ‘a kill-joy,’ ‘a morbid pietist,’ and ‘a sour bigot.’ His meaning, however, had been deliberately misrepresented. 1 Brown nowhere objects to all amusement per se , but amusement which masquerades as ministry, distracting the church and deceiving needy sinners. While the context in which Brown wrote may be different from ours, we need to hear his burden for a Church—and for Christians—to make a decisive break with the world and its practices. An Evil in the Camp of the Lord DIFFERENT days demand their own special testimony. The watchman who would be faithful to his Lord and the City of his God has need to carefully note the signs of the times and emphasize his witness accordingly. Con­cerning the testimony needed now, there can the little, if any, doubt. An evil is in the professed camp of the Lord—so gross, so brazen in its impudence—that the most short-sighted of spiritual men can hardly fail to notice it. During the past few years it has developed at an ab­normal rate, ever for evil. It has worked like leaven until now the whole lump ferments. Look which way you may, its presence makes itself manifest. There is little if any­thing, to choose between Church, Chapel, or Mission Hall. However they may differ in some respects, they bear a striking likeness in the posters that figure upon and dis­figure their notice boards. Amusement for the people i s the leading article advertised by each. If any of my readers doubt my statement, or think my utterance too sweeping, let them take a tour of inspection and study “the announce­ments for the week” at the doors of the sanctuaries of the neighbourhood; or let them read the religious advertise­ments in their local papers. I have done this again and again, until the hideous fact has been proved up to the hilt, that “amusement” is ousting the preaching of the gospel as the great attraction: “Concerts,” “Entertain­ments,” “Fancy Fairs,” “Smoking Conferences,” “Dramatic Performances,” are the words honoured with biggest type and most startling colours. The burden of the Lord is upon me in this matter The Concert is fast becoming as much a recognised part of church life as the Prayer Meeting, and is already, in most places, far better attended. “Providing recreation for the people” will soon be looked upon as a necessary part of Christian work and as binding upon the Church of God, as though it were a Divine command, unless some strong voices be raised which will make themselves heard. I do not presume to possess such a voice, but I do entertain the hope that I may awaken some louder echoes. Anyway, the burden of the Lord is upon me in this matter, and I leave it with Him to give my testimony ringing tone, or to let it die away in silence. I shall have delivered my soul in either case. Yet the conviction fills my mind that in all parts of the country there are faithful men and women who see the danger and deplore it and will endorse my witness and my warning. Gratifying the Flesh and Retaining a Comfortable Conscience It is only during the past few years that “amusement” has become a recognized weapon of our warfare and de­veloped into a mission. There has been a steady “down grade” in this respect. From “speaking out,” as the Puri­tans did, the Church has gradually toned down her testi­mony; then winked at and excused the frivolities of the day. Then she has tolerated them in her borders, and now she has adopted them and provided a home for them under the plea of “reaching the masses and getting the ear of the
articles.content_zh:
以下是阿奇博尔德·G·布朗(Archibald G. Brown)出版的一本小册子的实质内容,他是一个学生,后来成为了C·H·斯普亨在伦敦福音书事业中的重要盟友. Brown提醒大家注意他当时的教会日益盛行的一种做法:举行各种 " 纪念会 " 的做法,这种做法模糊不清,转移了注意力,有时还取代了当地教会的适当部会。

Brown在小册子发表后遭到野蛮攻击, 然而,他的意思被蓄意歪曲。 1 布朗无处反对所有娱乐本身, 但娱乐伪装成牧师, 分散教会的注意力 欺骗需要的罪人。

虽然布朗写作的背景可能与我们不同,但我们需要听取他对于一个教会——以及基督徒——的责任,以便同世界及其做法决裂。 魔王营里的恶魔 要求他们自己作证

忠于他的主和他所崇拜的城市的守望者,必须仔细记取时代的迹象,并相应地强调他的见证. 在现在所需要的证词中,可以有一点怀疑。 主所宣示的营中,有恶行;主的营中,有恶行;主的营中,有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行;有恶行。

在过去几年里,它以异常的速度发展,永远是邪恶的。 直到现在,它一直工作着,就像离开一样。 看看你们可以走哪条路,它的存在就变得明显了。 教会、礼拜堂或传教堂之间几乎没有任何选择。

然而,它们在某些方面可能有所不同,它们在海报上带有惊人的相似性,这些海报上显示它们的通知板并毁容。 为人民提供娱乐 我是每篇广告的主要文章

如果我的读者怀疑我的发言,或者认为我的言论过于笼统,让他们巡视视察,在附近圣所门口研究“一周的公告”;或者让他们在当地报纸上阅读宗教广告。

在令人发指的事实被证实之前,我一再这样做,即“辱骂”正在驱使福音的传道成为伟大的取景:“关注”、“参与”、“盛会”、“吸烟会”、“戏剧表演”是用最出名和最令人惊叹的颜色表达的言论。

主的重担在我这里 音乐会正迅速成为教会生活中 公认的部分 与祈祷会一样 并且已经,在大多数地方,

“为人民提供娱乐”将很快被视为基督教工作的必要部分,对上帝的教会具有约束力,似乎这是神的命令,除非有人发出强烈的声音,让自己听到。 我并不认为拥有这种声音,但我确实希望能够唤起一些更响亮的回声。

无论如何,上帝的重任 由我负责这件事, 我留给他 让我的证词响亮的语气, 或者让它静静地死去。 无论哪种情况,我都会送出我的灵魂 然而,这一信念使我满怀信心,即全国各地都有忠实的男女看到这种危险并对此感到痛惜,并将赞同我的证人和我的警告。

修行并保持舒适的良知 直到过去几年,“暴行”才成为我们战争的公认武器并发展成一个特派团。 这方面的“级别”稳步下降。 正如普里坦人所做的那样,教会从“大声疾呼”开始,逐渐淡出她的遗言;然后轻视并原谅了今天的纷争。

然后,她在边境上容忍他们,现在她收养了他们,在“影响群众,让人民听到他们的声音”的恳求下,为他们提供了家园。
